stock.description: New Century Group Hong Kong Limited, an investment holding company, engages in money lending, property investment, and securities trading business in Hong Kong and Southeast Asia. It offers mortgage and unsecured personal loans; invests in office space and commercial shops; and trades marketable securities for short-term investment purposes. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong. New Century Group Hong Kong Limited is a subsidiary of New Century Investment Pacific Limited.
